name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: An animated radio group for React and shadcn, with plain radios or selectable cards.

meta.details: Radios whose dot scales out from the centre on a snappy spring, and radio cards whose selected border travels between cards. Base UI RadioGroup behaviour.

docs: Import RadioGroup, Radio, RadioCards and RadioCard from components/eased/radio-group/radio-group. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
